hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer package-owned companion serial-line exchange smoke
hardware.tested_state: existing flashed firmware exercised after companion serial-line exchange refactor

procedure: Refactored nSealr/companion so exchangeSerialLineRequest in packages/transport owns one-shot serial-line validation, port opening, exchange, and close sequencing.
Kept nseal serial-line exchange as the CLI file/argument wrapper over that package-owned boundary.

Ran nSealr/lab hardware_companion_serial_smoke.py in default companion-serial-line mode against /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 for get-capabilities with request_id lab-companion-serial-line-refactor-2026-05-11.
Ran the same lab smoke in default companion-serial-line mode for sign-event-disabled with request_id lab-companion-serial-line-refactor-sign-disabled-2026-05-11.
No firmware reflash was performed for this report; the attached board was already running ESP32 firmware revision 0dda7d6 from the animated QR host-core smoke.
expected_result: The package-owned companion serial-line exchange boundary still opens the attached board only after request validation, verifies the get-capabilities response, and verifies a companion-generated sign_event refusal with signing_disabled.
observed_result: The get-capabilities smoke passed with response_ok true for request_id lab-companion-serial-line-refactor-2026-05-11. The sign-event-disabled smoke passed with response_ok false and response_error_code signing_disabled for request_id lab-companion-serial-line-refactor-sign-disabled-2026-05-11. Both runs used exchange_mode companion-serial-line after the companion refactor.
limitations: This is protocol smoke for a companion transport refactor against an existing flashed firmware image; it is not a new build or flash report.
This is not a new manual visual display inspection, physical button approval test, camera test, or QR flow test.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, key provisioning, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or real signing.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
